About.title: About me
About.p1: Senior Full-Stack & AI Architect based in South Korea, living and building in the Korean tech ecosystem since 2023. I specialize in taking mission-critical platforms and production AI from zero to scale as an autonomous end-to-end builder — fluent in English, Korean, and Russian.
About.p2: Architected the core backend for Blue Networks' E-Chae-Um EV CSMS across 1,600+ chargers in 500+ locations using Java 17, Spring Boot, MyBatis, and sharded databases — delivering OCPP 1.6J/2.0.1 bidirectional WebSocket telemetry, bulk OTA firmware distribution, and national KECO inter-operator roaming data (로밍 데이터) synchronization with Smartro PG settlements.
About.p3: Engineered the AI-powered EV Power Demand Forecasting & Contract Optimization Platform: combining an 8-model ensemble (PyTorch LSTM, XGBoost, and GEV/GPD Extreme Value Theory) to forecast peak power loads in P50/P90 probabilistic quantiles, significantly reducing KEPCO electricity tariffs and peak surcharge penalties.
About.p4: Today, I specialize in shipping modern AI SaaS platforms, streaming LLM agents (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), multilingual STT/TTS, and reactive Next.js 15 / TypeScript full-stack architectures containerized across Docker, Linux, AWS, and GCP.
